summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Ecovera Sourcing corporate website. Backend APIs are fully functional with 100% success rate. Frontend pages load correctly with proper navigation, forms work, and user authentication flows are operational.

integration_issues.issue: User gets logged out when navigating directly to protected routes like /portal/orders

passed_tests: All backend API endpoints (40/40 tests passed)
Homepage loads with hero section, services, stats, testimonials, FAQ
Navigation links work (Home, Services, About, FAQ, Contact)
Contact page loads and contact form submission works
Quote page loads and quote request form submission works
FAQ page loads with search and filter functionality
Client Portal Dashboard loads after login
Orders CRUD API endpoints work correctly
Suppliers CRUD API endpoints work correctly
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix session persistence issue where users get logged out when navigating directly to protected portal routes. This appears to be a token storage/retrieval issue in the frontend authentication context.
